name: proxmox-tools
description: Secure Proxmox VE inspection and controlled guest lifecycle operations over the Proxmox API, with administrator-configured profiles, pinned-CA TLS, and capability detection.
author: Sidekick

profiles.description: Administrator-configured Proxmox environments, keyed by profile name. Endpoints and credential references live here; secret VALUES never do.

endpoint.description: Proxmox API origin, https only, e.g. https://pve.example.internal:8006 (no path/query/credentials).

token_ref.description: Secret store reference for the API token, of the form secret:<name>. The value is resolved server-side and never returned.

ca_pem.description: Optional PEM CA certificate to pin (e.g. the Proxmox cluster CA) for self-signed installations. TLS verification stays on.

ca_secret_ref.description: Optional secret store reference (secret:<name>) holding the pinned CA PEM, as an alternative to ca_pem.

task_timeout_ms.description: Maximum wait for a task to reach a terminal state (default 120000).

allow_lifecycle.description: When true, this profile permits start/shutdown/reboot. Defaults to false: a profile is read-only unless an administrator opts in.

default.description: Mark this profile the default when more than one is configured.
